claims.quote: Our facilities management team struggles with regional coordination.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your facilities management team is struggling with regional coordination, and you are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting would be a great opportunity to explore your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. We will schedule a discovery session at your convenience.
questions: What specific challenges are you facing with regional coordination in your facilities management?
Are there any existing systems or tools currently in use that you would like to integrate with Cedar Systems?
What are your expectations for the workflow coordination and account reporting features?
uncertainties: The customer has not yet approved a budget, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
The specific integration requirements are not yet defined, so the discovery meeting will be crucial to clarify these.
